questions.enonce_markdown: Distinguish and list an example on each of the three (3) types of frying. (6 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Three types of frying.**

| Type of frying | How it is done | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Shallow frying | Food is cooked in a small amount of hot fat or oil in a frying pan and is turned over to cook both sides. | Fried eggs, fish steaks, pancakes |
| Deep frying | Food is completely covered by hot fat or oil in a deep pan. | Chips, puff-puff, doughnuts |
| Dry frying | Food is cooked in a pan with no added fat, because the food gives out enough fat itself. | Bacon, sausages |

questions.enonce_markdown: State eight (8) rules to follow when frying foods. (8 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Eight rules to follow when frying foods.**

1. Use a good-quality fat or oil with a high smoking point.
2. Heat the fat to the right temperature before adding the food (a cube of bread should turn golden brown in about one minute).
3. Dry the food well before frying, because water makes the fat spit.
4. Do not put too much food in the pan at one time, because this lowers the temperature and makes the food greasy.
5. Never fill the pan more than about half full of fat for deep frying.
6. Coat moist foods (with flour, batter, or egg and breadcrumbs) to protect them and give a crisp surface.
7. Drain the fried food on absorbent paper before serving.
8. Never leave hot fat unattended, and keep the pan handle turned inward and out of the way of children.

(Also acceptable: strain and store the fat after use; if the fat catches fire cover the pan with a lid or damp cloth and never pour water on it.)

questions.enonce_markdown: Enumerate six (6) uses of wood as a material used for making kitchen equipment. (6 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Six uses of wood in making kitchen equipment.**

1. Chopping boards.
2. Wooden spoons and spatulas.
3. Rolling pins.
4. Mortars and pestles (or grinding tools).
5. Handles of knives, pans and other utensils.
6. Bread boards, tables, shelves and cupboards.

(Other acceptable answers: salad servers, stirring sticks, draining racks.)

questions.enonce_markdown: State five (5) points to remember when preparing vegetable salads. (5 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Five points to remember when preparing vegetable salads.**

1. Use fresh, crisp vegetables of good quality.
2. Wash the vegetables thoroughly in clean water, and drain and dry them well.
3. Prepare the salad shortly before it is eaten and use a sharp stainless-steel knife or tear the leaves, so that vitamins are not lost and the vegetables do not wilt.
4. Add the dressing just before serving so that the salad does not become soggy.
5. Serve the salad cold and make it look attractive, with a mixture of colours and textures and a neat garnish.
